title: In Silico Search for Drug Candidates Targeting the PAX8-PPARgamma Fusion Protein in Thyroid Cancer.
authors: Sakaguchi, Kaori; Okiyama, Yoshio; Tanaka, Shigenori
one_liner_zh: 该文通过ensemble-docking和MM-PBSA对甲状腺癌中PAX8-PPARgamma融合蛋白进行药物筛选，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白融合体系与分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白结合而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI或MD动态机制研究，仅间接相关。
abstract: The PAX8/PPARgamma rearrangement, producing the PAX8-PPARgamma fusion protein (PPFP), is thought to play an essential role in the oncogenesis of thyroid follicular tumors. To identify PPFP-targeted drug candidates and establish an early standard of care for thyroid tumors, we performed ensemble-docking-based compound screening. Specifically, we investigated the pocket structure that should be adopted to search for a promising ligand compound for the PPFP; the position of the ligand-binding pocket on the PPARgamma side of the PPFP is similar to that of PPARgamma; however, the shape is slightly different between them due to environmental factors. We developed a method for selecting a PPFP structure with a relevant pocket and high prediction accuracy for ligand binding. This method was validated using PPARgamma, whose structure and activity values are known for many compounds. Then, we performed docking calculations to the PPFP for 97 drug or drug-like compounds registered in the DrugBank database with a thiazolidine backbone, which is one of the characteristics of ligands that bind well to PPARgamma. Furthermore, the binding affinities of promising ligand candidates were estimated more reliably using the molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area method. Thus, we propose promising drug candidates for the PPFP with a thiazolidine backbone.
abstract_zh: PAX8/PPARgamma重排产生PAX8-PPARgamma融合蛋白（PPFP），被认为在甲状腺滤泡性肿瘤的致癌过程中发挥关键作用。为识别PPFP靶向药物候选物并建立甲状腺肿瘤的早期标准治疗方案，我们进行了基于整体对接的化合物筛选。具体而言，我们研究了应采用何种口袋结构来寻找PPFP的有前景配体化合物；PPFP中PPARgamma侧配体结合口袋的位置与PPARgamma相似；然而，由于环境因素，两者之间的形状略有不同。我们开发了一种方法，用于选择具有相关口袋且配体结合预测准确度高的PPFP结构。该方法使用PPARgamma进行验证，该蛋白的结构和活性值对许多化合物已知。随后，我们对DrugBank数据库中注册的97种具有噻唑烷骨架的药物或类药物化合物进行了针对PPFP的对接计算，噻唑烷骨架是与PPARgamma良好结合的配体特征之一。此外，使用分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积方法更可靠地估计了有前景配体候选物的结合亲和力。因此，我们提出了具有噻唑烷骨架的PPFP的有前景药物候选物。
